title: Grilled Chicken Kebabs
summary: Juicy kebabs marinated in Middle Eastern Manqual, grilled until smoky and tender.
ingredients: Flatbreads and yogurt sauce, to serve
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and Manqual in a bowl.
Add the chicken, toss to coat and marinate for 1 hour.
Heat the grill to medium-high.
Thread chicken, onion and pepper onto skewers.
Grill 12–15 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with warm flatbreads and yogurt sauce.

title: Fiesta Guacamole
summary: Creamy guacamole lifted with Hacienda Salsa Guacamole — zesty, fresh and made for dipping.
ingredients: ¼ cup red onion, finely chopped
steps: Halve the avocados, remove the pits and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork, leaving it a little chunky.
Stir in the lime juice and Hacienda Salsa Guacamole.
Fold through the tomato, red onion, jalapeño and cilantro.
Taste, adjust with more lime or seasoning, and serve right away with chips.

title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
summary: Slow-cooked lamb with Tangier Ras El Hanout, dried fruit and tomatoes — a rich, royal Moroccan feast.
steps: Toss the lamb with Ras El Hanout until coated.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven and brown the lamb on all sides.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Stir in broth and tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
Add apricots and raisins, cover and simmer 1½–2 hours until tender.
Scatter with almonds and cilantro; serve with couscous or flatbread.

title: Spicy Beef Stir-Fry
summary: A bold, fiery stir-fry with Szechuan Five Spice, tender beef and crisp vegetables. Weeknight perfect.
steps: Marinate the beef with soy sauce and 1 tbsp Five Spice for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat; sear the beef for 3 minutes, then remove.
Stir-fry onion, pepper and snow peas for 5 minutes.
Return the beef, add remaining Five Spice and the vinegar; toss to coat.
Serve hot over rice.

title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken & Vegetables
summary: A fragrant Thai classic simmered with Bangkok Green Curry, coconut milk and fresh vegetables.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat.
Add chicken and sauté until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in Bangkok Green Curry and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar; stir well.
Add the vegetables and simmer 10–12 minutes.
Taste, adjust, and serve with basil and steamed rice.

title: Pink Salt & Citrus Salmon
summary: Crisp-skinned salmon finished with freshly cracked pink salt and a squeeze of citrus.
ingredients: 1 lemon, zested and cut into wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and pat the salmon very dry.
Toss broccoli and tomatoes with half the oil and a grind of pink salt on a sheet pan; roast 5 minutes.
Rub the salmon with the remaining oil, add to the pan skin-side up and roast 10 minutes.
Finish with citrus zest and a generous grind of pink salt; serve with lemon wedges.

title: Smoked Salt Jammy Eggs on Toast
summary: Six-and-a-half-minute eggs, buttered sourdough and a campfire finish of smoked salt.
ingredients: Chili oil or hot sauce, optional
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook exactly 6½ minutes, then plunge into ice water.
Toast and butter the sourdough.
Peel and halve the eggs; arrange on toast with the avocado.
Grind over smoked salt, add chives and a drizzle of chili oil.

title: Street-Cart Mango Cups
summary: Mexico's favourite fruit-cart snack — mango, cucumber and jicama, lime and a fiery hit of chili salt.
steps: Stand the fruit and vegetable spears in cups.
Squeeze over plenty of lime juice.
Grind or shake Spicy Chili Salt over the top.
Add a drizzle of chamoy if you like it extra tangy, and eat immediately.

title: Crispy Herb Salt Potatoes
summary: Parboiled, shaken and roasted until shatteringly crisp, then showered with herb salt.
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F. Boil the potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes; drain.
Shake them in the pot to rough up the edges.
Toss with oil, garlic and rosemary on a hot sheet pan.
Roast 35–40 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Finish with a generous grind of Herb Salt.

title: Overnight Herb-Brined Turkey Breast
summary: A simple overnight brine for the juiciest holiday turkey breast you've ever carved.
steps: Dissolve the Turkey Brine Blend in 4 cups warm water, then add the remaining cold water and the orange.
Submerge the turkey and refrigerate 12–18 hours.
Rinse, pat very dry and rub with butter and chopped herbs.
Roast at 350°F for about 1½ hours, until 160°F in the thickest part.
Rest 20 minutes before carving.

title: Sweet & Spicy Glazed Ham
summary: A crackly brown-sugar glaze with a cayenne wink — naughty, nice and the star of the table.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F. Set the ham in a roasting pan, cover with foil and bake 1 hour.
Simmer the rub, brown sugar, mustard, orange juice and honey for 3 minutes.
Uncover the ham, brush with half the glaze and raise the heat to 400°F.
Bake 20–25 minutes more, glazing again halfway, until lacquered and caramelised.

title: Gingerbread Skillet Cookie
summary: A chewy, molasses-dark cookie baked in one pan and served warm with ice cream.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and butter a 10-inch skillet.
Whisk butter, sugar, molasses and egg; stir in Gingerbread Spice.
Fold in flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Press into the skillet and bake 20–22 minutes until set at the edges.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

title: Harvest Roasted Roots with Maple
summary: Carrots, parsnips and squash roasted with herbs and a maple gloss.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the vegetables into even chunks and toss with oil and Harvest Herb Rub.
Spread on two sheet pans and roast 35 minutes, turning once.
Drizzle with maple syrup and roast 5 minutes more.

title: Classic Sunday Roast Chicken
summary: Golden skin, juicy meat and a pan of herby drippings for gravy.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and pat the chicken dry.
Mash butter with Poultry Seasoning and salt; rub under and over the skin.
Stuff with lemon and onion; set in a roasting pan with the stock.
Roast 65–75 minutes until the thigh reads 165°F.
Rest 15 minutes; whisk the drippings into a quick gravy.

title: Texas-Style Oven Ribs
summary: Low-and-slow ribs with a peppery bark — no smoker required.
steps: Heat the oven to 275°F. Remove the membrane from the ribs.
Brush with mustard and coat generously with BBQ Seasoning.
Wrap tightly in foil and bake 2½ hours.
Unwrap, brush with sauce mixed with vinegar and broil 3–5 minutes until sticky.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Shawarma
summary: All the street-stall flavour, made on one pan — crisp-edged chicken, pickles and garlic sauce.
ingredients: Garlic sauce or tahini, pickles, tomatoes
steps: Toss the chicken with Shawarma, oil and lemon; marinate 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 450°F and spread chicken and onion on a sheet pan.
Roast 25–30 minutes until charred at the edges, then slice.
Pile into warm pitas with garlic sauce, pickles and tomatoes.

title: Asado Skirt Steak with Chimichurri
summary: Fast, fiery skirt steak with a bright chimichurri — the Sunday parrilla, any night of the week.
steps: Coat the steak with Asado Rub and let it sit while the grill heats.
Stir parsley, garlic, oil, vinegar and 1 tsp rub into a chimichurri.
Grill over high heat 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 minutes, slice against the grain and spoon over chimichurri.

title: Za'atar Manakish
summary: Lebanon's breakfast flatbread — soft dough, olive oil and a thick layer of za'atar.
ingredients: Labneh, cucumber, tomato and mint, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F with a sheet pan inside.
Divide the dough into 4 and stretch into rounds.
Mix olive oil and Za'atar into a paste and spread over the dough, leaving a rim.
Bake on the hot pan 8–10 minutes until golden.
Serve warm with labneh and fresh vegetables.

title: Crackling Sunday Pork Shoulder
summary: Fennel-and-sage pork with crackling worth fighting over, roasted on a bed of apples.
ingredients: 4 lb boneless pork shoulder, skin scored
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F. Rub the pork all over with oil and the rub, working it into the scores.
Set on the apples and onions in a roasting pan and roast 30 minutes.
Add the cider, lower to 325°F and roast 3–3½ hours until tender.
Rest 20 minutes, then pull or slice with the crackling and pan apples.

title: Citrus Herb Baked Cod
summary: Flaky cod roasted on lemon slices with butter and a bright herb crust.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and lay the lemon slices and asparagus on a sheet pan.
Set the cod on the lemons.
Mix butter, Citrus Herb Blend and panko; spoon over the fish.
Bake 12–15 minutes until the fish flakes easily.

title: Chili Lime Elote
summary: Charred corn slathered in crema, rolled in cotija and zapped with chili lime.
ingredients: ¼ cup mayonnaise or Mexican crema
steps: Grill the corn over high heat, turning, until charred in spots, about 10 minutes.
Brush each ear with crema.
Roll in cotija and shake over Citrus Chili Lime.
Finish with cilantro and lime wedges.

title: Chai Sugar Affogato
summary: Vanilla ice cream, hot espresso and a crunchy shower of chai sugar — dessert in two minutes.
steps: Scoop the ice cream into two small glasses.
Sprinkle with Chai Sugar.
Pour the hot espresso over at the table.
Top with crushed biscotti and eat straight away.

title: Cinnamon Sugar Churro Bites
summary: Crisp, puffy choux bites rolled warm in cinnamon sugar, with chocolate for dipping.
steps: Bring water and butter to a boil; stir in the flour until a ball forms.
Cool 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Pipe small rounds into 350°F oil and fry until golden, 2–3 minutes.
Toss warm in Cinnamon Sugar and serve with chocolate sauce.

title: Penne all'Arrabbiata
summary: Rome's angry pasta — garlic, chile and tomatoes, ready in the time it takes to boil water.
steps: Cook the penne in well-salted water until al dente.
Meanwhile, sizzle the garlic and Arrabbiata in olive oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and a splash of pasta water; finish with pecorino and parsley.

title: Spaghetti al Limone
summary: Amalfi's summer pasta — silky, lemony and on the table in 15 minutes.
steps: Cook the spaghetti until al dente, adding peas for the last 2 minutes; reserve 1 cup water.
Melt butter with Lemon Herb and lemon zest in a large pan.
Add the pasta, lemon juice, Parmesan and a splash of pasta water.
Toss vigorously until glossy; serve at once.

title: Chili Garlic Hot Honey Pizza
summary: Crisp-cupped pepperoni, hot honey and a chili garlic crust — the slice-shop favourite at home.
steps: Heat the oven to its hottest setting with a pizza stone or steel inside.
Stretch the dough and top with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni.
Brush the crust with olive oil and shake over half the Chili Garlic.
Bake 10–12 minutes until blistered.
Warm the honey with the remaining Chili Garlic and drizzle over.

title: Pizzeria Garlic Knots
summary: Soft, buttery knots tossed in garlic and Pizzeria Herb, with marinara for dunking.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Cut the dough into 12 strips and tie each into a knot.
Bake on a lined sheet 12–15 minutes until golden.
Stir butter, garlic and Pizzeria Herb together.
Toss the hot knots in the garlic butter and Parmesan; serve with marinara.

title: Sicilian Sheet-Pan Focaccia
summary: Bubbly, olive-oil-rich focaccia with tomatoes, onions and Sicilian Sprinkle — a nod to Palermo's sfincione.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt and water into a shaggy dough; cover and rest 2 hours.
Pour half the oil into a sheet pan, add the dough and stretch to the corners.
Dimple deeply, top with tomatoes and onion and drizzle with remaining oil.
Shower with Sicilian Sprinkle and bake at 450°F for 22–25 minutes.

title: Grilled Caesar Wedges
summary: Charred romaine, a punchy shake-and-whisk dressing and garlicky croutons — Tijuana's classic, sharpened.
steps: Whisk mayonnaise, lemon juice and Caesar-Style into a dressing.
Brush the romaine with oil and grill cut-side down 2–3 minutes until charred.
Drizzle with dressing.
Finish with croutons, Parmesan and another shake of seasoning.

title: Horiatiki Greek Salad
summary: The taverna salad — juicy tomatoes, cucumber, olives and a slab of feta. No lettuce allowed.
steps: Arrange tomatoes, cucumber, onion, pepper and olives in a shallow bowl.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Greek Style.
Lay the feta on top and pour over the dressing.
Finish with another pinch of seasoning and serve with crusty bread.

title: Green Goddess Crunch Bowl
summary: Cabbage, cucumber and herbs in a creamy Green Goddess yogurt dressing — crunchy, green and endlessly snackable.
steps: Whisk yogurt, lemon juice and Green Goddess with a splash of water.
Toss cabbage, cucumber and chives with the dressing.
Top with avocado and pepitas.
Eat as is, or scoop up with tortilla chips.

title: Chicken Paprikash
summary: Hungary's comfort classic — chicken braised in a velvety, brick-red paprika and sour cream sauce.
steps: Brown the seasoned chicken in butter; set aside.
Cook the onions gently until soft and golden, 10 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the Paprika, then add the stock and chicken.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Whisk sour cream with flour, stir in and simmer 2 minutes. Serve over noodles.

title: Patatas Bravas
summary: Crispy potatoes, smoky pimentón sauce and garlic aioli — Madrid's favourite tapa.
steps: Roast the potatoes with oil and salt at 450°F for 35–40 minutes until crisp.
Simmer tomatoes, garlic, cayenne and Smoked Paprika for 10 minutes.
Spoon the bravas sauce over the potatoes.
Finish with aioli and an extra dusting of pimentón.

title: Herb & Chive Champ
summary: Irish champ — fluffy, buttery mash with warm milk, green onions and herbs.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender; drain and steam dry.
Warm the milk with the green onions for 5 minutes.
Mash the potatoes with the milk and half the butter.
Fold in Herb & Chive Potatoes; serve with the rest of the butter melting on top.

title: Golden Tadka Dal
summary: Creamy yellow lentils finished with a sizzling tadka — India's everyday comfort food.
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split lentils (toor or moong dal)
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer with water, Turmeric and salt for 30 minutes until soft.
Whisk to a creamy consistency, adding water if needed.
Heat ghee; fry cumin, garlic and chile until golden.
Pour the sizzling tadka over the dal; finish with cilantro and lime.

title: Sheet-Pan Ratatouille
summary: Provence's summer stew, roasted on one pan so every vegetable gets a little char.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss all the vegetables and garlic with oil, Herbes de Provence and salt.
Roast 40–45 minutes, stirring once, until jammy and charred.
Finish with torn basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Mulled Apple Cider
summary: A pot of cider simmered with cinnamon, orange and cloves — your house will smell incredible.
steps: Combine everything in a large pot.
Bring just to a simmer, then lower the heat.
Steep 20 minutes without boiling.
Ladle into mugs with a cinnamon stick for stirring.

title: Quick Dill Pickles
summary: Crunchy refrigerator pickles, ready by tomorrow's lunch.
steps: Slice the cucumbers into spears and pack into a 1-quart jar with garlic.
Bring vinegar, water, salt and sugar to a boil.
Add Whole Dill and mustard seeds to the jar and pour over the hot brine.
Cool, seal and refrigerate at least 24 hours.

title: Fennel & Orange Pork Chops
summary: Toasted fennel seed crust, juicy chops and a quick orange pan sauce.
steps: Rub the chops with crushed fennel, salt, pepper and orange zest.
Sear in oil over medium-high heat, 4–5 minutes per side.
Rest the chops; add orange juice and butter to the pan and swirl into a sauce.
Spoon the sauce over the chops.

title: Cinnamon Swirl Banana Bread
summary: Moist banana bread with a ribbon of cinnamon sugar through the middle.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a loaf pan.
Mash bananas; whisk in butter, brown sugar, egg and vanilla.
Fold in flour, baking soda and 1 tsp cinnamon.
Layer half the batter, the remaining cinnamon mixed with sugar, then the rest of the batter.
Bake 55–60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

title: Silky Ginger Carrot Soup
summary: Bright carrot soup with warm ginger and a swirl of coconut milk.
steps: Soften the onion in oil, then stir in Ground Ginger for 30 seconds.
Add carrots and stock; simmer 25 minutes until tender.
Blend until silky, then stir in the coconut milk.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lime.

title: Herb-Heavy Tabbouleh
summary: The Lebanese way — mostly parsley, a little bulgur and plenty of lemon.
steps: Soak the bulgur in the lemon juice with the dried Parsley for 15 minutes.
Combine fresh parsley, tomatoes, green onions and mint.
Add the bulgur and olive oil and toss well.
Season with salt and serve with romaine leaves for scooping.

title: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
summary: Slow-roasted tomatoes blended with basil and a little cream — grilled cheese not optional.
steps: Roast tomatoes, onion and garlic with oil at 400°F for 40 minutes.
Transfer to a pot with the stock and Basil; simmer 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir in the cream.
Season and serve with grilled cheese.

title: Weeknight Phở Bò
summary: A shortcut phở with charred aromatics and star anise — deep, fragrant broth in under an hour.
ingredients: 1 onion and a 3-inch piece ginger, halved
Basil, bean sprouts, lime and chile
steps: Char the onion and ginger in a dry pan until blackened in spots.
Toast the star anise and cinnamon, then add broth, onion and ginger; simmer 40 minutes.
Strain and season with fish sauce and sugar.
Divide cooked noodles and raw beef among bowls and ladle over the boiling broth.
Top with herbs, sprouts, lime and chile.
